summary: Existing HttpPartitionTest covers a partition and recovery but not a queued streaming-client stall. TlogLeaderElectionFrozenLeaderTest demonstrates a controllable Jetty filter, but targets replication downloads, not leader-to-replica updates. A deterministic real stall requires Linux reproduction and queue-precondition validation before a permanent test can be specified safely; route to a capable Linux host. No source was edited or executor started on Windows.
